newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary retail, catering sales drop 5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Hungary retail, catering sales drop 5 pct in 1996.

text.p: Turnover in Hungary's retail and catering fell five percent in real terms in 1996 than in 1995, the Central Statistical Office (KSH) said on Tuesday.
Retail and catering turnover totalled 2,791 billion forints ($15.9 billion) in 1996, up 17 percent from nominal prices from 1995, it said.
Retail sales, amounting to 2,594 billion forints in 1996, increased 17 percent in nominal terms in 1996, but real volume dropped 4.9 percent, the KSH said.
Food retail sales increased seven percent in real terms, but their share in total retail sales rose three percent to 34 percent, it said.
"This favourable trend indicates that the hidden economy, not measurable by statistics, has been increasingly driven out from this area," it added.
